name: Skills and Workforce Development Agency

scam_info.sample: an organisation known as “Singapore Business School” (“SBS”) has been advertising Master's Degree programmes through its website, www.sbs-online.world . ... SBS is NOT a private education institution (“PEI”) registered with SWDA.
scam_info.notes: Private-education 'Alerts and advisories' page (sitemap lastmod 2026-11-04 = latest_item_date); currently one alert naming an unregistered PEI and its website (domain sbs-online.world, text only, not visited). Other SWDA scam-keyword URLs are SkillsFuture-grant fraud convictions (newsroom, 2026-09). Legacy https://www.ssg.gov.sg/scam-advisory/ now redirects to www.swda.gov.sg/scam-advisory -> HTTP 404 (retired after SSG+WSG merger into SWDA in 2026). skillsfuture.gov.sg sitemap (100 URLs) has no scam page.

notes: 2026 restructuring per SGDI: SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) + Workforce Singapore (WSG) -> SWDA; www.ssg.gov.sg and www.wsg.gov.sg redirect to www.swda.gov.sg (same 392-395 URL sitemap) (b). skillsfuture.gov.sg and tpgateway.gov.sg linked from SWDA nav (b). MyCareersFuture (www.mycareersfuture.gov.sg, national jobs portal; 135k+ URLs incl. /companies/<name>-<UEN>) is a job-scam ALLOWLIST source (company names + UEN) - no scam pages found. Unverified (search snippet): 2017 SPF/SSG advisory on door-to-door impersonators harvesting Singpass for SkillsFuture Credit claims.

scam_info.sample: Government officials will NEVER do these things over a phone call: Ask you to transfer money. Ask you to disclose bank log-in details. ...
scam_info.notes: Generic whole-of-government scam page + 'Contact us to report MOE-related scams or phishing attempts.' Narrative. Sitemap (5,943 URLs, lastmod) otherwise has only PQ replies on scam education (latest 2026-11-03 'expanding financial literacy and scam awareness modules').

name: Ministry of Social and Family Development
aliases: Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF)

scam_info.sample: Beware of scams. MSF will not ask you to send money, give us your credit card information, banking login details or One-Time Passwords (OTP) via SMS or messaging apps.
scam_info.notes: Narrative; gov.sg SMS sender-ID infographic (EN/ZH/MS/TA); MSF hotline 1800 111 2222 to report MSF-related scams; still cites old anti-scam helpline 1800 772 6688 and Scam Alert site. latest_item_date = sitemap lastmod. robots.txt declares no sitemap; /sitemap.xml fetched directly (1,655 URLs).

notes: official_domains msf.gov.sg (b). Assistance-scheme payouts (e.g. ComCare) are common scam lures but MSF lists no fake sites.

scam_info.sample: The following 45 businesses have admitted to procuring fake reviews as part of the first phase of CCS’s investigations: List of businesses who have procured fake reviews S/N Registered business name
scam_info.notes: Table of 45 registered business names that procured fake online reviews (plus a fake-review provider). Last updated 9 October 2026. Consumer-deception, not scam IOCs per se.

CPFTA (Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act) public case register: 32 case URLs under /case-register/public-register/consumer-protection--fair-trading-/ naming errant retailers (e.g. fake reviews: Lambency Detailing on sgcarmart.com, Loft Home Furnishing). latest = sitemap lastmod.

notes: 2026 rename CCCS -> CCS (SGDI); www.cccs.gov.sg serves the same sitemap as www.ccs.gov.sg (b). Consumer complaints are handled by CASE (case.org.sg).
